description: Read cell contents from a range, or its formatting with mode "formats". Large ranges are truncated; use next_range to continue.

account.description: Google account to use: an email or unique part of one (e.g. "acme.com"). Default: the account that can open the spreadsheet, else the default account.

mode.description: values = as displayed; formulas = show formulas instead of results; raw = unformatted numbers; formats = cell formatting (fill, font, alignment, number format, borders) as a style table plus a per-row map of style ids, with merges, banding, conditional formats, column widths, frozen panes and gridlines

range.description: A1 range, e.g. "Sheet1!A1:D20", "'My Tab'!B:B", or a tab name

spreadsheet.description: Google Sheets link or spreadsheet ID. The name of a spreadsheet used with Sheets MCP before also works

name: read_range
title: Read cells
